name: PipeMFL-240K
description: PipeMFL-240K is a large-scale benchmark for object detection in pipeline magnetic flux leakage pseudo-color images. It is designed to support reliable and reproducible evaluation of models for industrial inspection under challenging conditions such as tiny objects, severe class imbalance, and long-tailed category distributions.
evaluation_method: Object detection metrics such as mAP, typically including AP at IoU thresholds and class-wise detection performance
notes: Targets pipeline integrity inspection using MFL imagery. The dataset is notable for a long-tailed distribution across 12 categories and a high prevalence of tiny objects, making detection especially difficult.
